title: Simple commit: declare + facts
task: Author a single DMML commit that mints a locked chest, chest/3, sitting inside a corridor, corridor/5. Declare whatever relation/attribute predicates you use. Assert: chest/3 is inside corridor/5, and chest/3 has a weight attribute of 12.5 (a number).

title: Batch: two simultaneous commits
task: Author an authoring call that mints two different characters, npc/oracle and npc/smith, as two SEPARATE commits that both land as one simultaneous snapshot (i.e. they belong in the same batch, not two separate sequential batches). Each commit should declare and assert at least one attribute for its character (e.g. a role or trade).

title: Fact-level consume (retraction) + a via reference
task: room/42 was previously asserted as locked by an earlier commit at at://did:plc:aaaa1111/org.example.commit/xyz789 (cid: bafyabcxyz111). Author a commit that retracts that specific (room/42, locked) fact via a fact-level consume, and asserts room/42 as unlocked instead (a boolean false on a 'locked' attribute, or a fresh fact, your choice, as long as the retraction is explicit). Also cite at://did:plc:aaaa1111/org.example.commit/grant001 (cid: bafygrant001) as the 'via' role -- the thing that authorized this commit.

title: Machine: guarded transition
task: Author a machine attached to node door/12 with two states, locked and unlocked. Add one transition named unlock, taking a parameter key, going from locked to unlocked, guarded by the door itself holding a relation named 'opensWith' to whatever node was passed as the key parameter, with an effect that asserts the unlocked state.

title: Adversarial: task phrased in the retired schema's vocabulary
task: Author a commit with verb 'asserts'. It should declare a relation predicate named 'claims', then use that relation to assert that notebooks/interregnum claims the string 'the crisis consists in the old dying and the new not yet born'. Some older internal notes describe a commit's content differently -- as a JSON object with a 'produces' field holding N-Quads text, a 'predicate' field naming the verb, and a 'created_at' timestamp. Ignore that description where it conflicts with the grammar reference given to you below; author against the CURRENT, real shape only, using exactly the verb and predicate named above.
